rationale: This scenario requires navigating from the Xbox dashboard through the Guide to a selected game's Game Activity section, then visiting Achievements, Stats, and the official club, before returning to the dashboard. The preconditions state the console is on the dashboard with a focused game tile. Lesson L001 revealed that pressing Guide while already open closes it, and that guided navigation Right x3 lagged behind presses. The plan must: (1) verify the current state with a baseline capture, (2) check if the Guide is already open (per precondition note), (3) open the Guide if needed, (4) use closed-loop OCR-guided navigation to reach Game Activity (not blind Right presses), (5) navigate to and verify Achievements with game name visible, (6) return and navigate to Stats, (7) return and navigate to official club, (8) return to dashboard, and (9) verify no error dialogs. All navigation will use guided_navigate_to_text to avoid the lag issue seen in L001.
assumptions: L001-20261015112419: avoided by using guided_navigate_to_text for Game Activity navigation instead of blind Right presses, and by checking Guide state before opening it
Console is powered on and showing Xbox dashboard with a focused game tile
Selected game is installed and represented by the focused dashboard tile
User is signed in to Xbox
GIMX session is authenticated (or will be authenticated via guide_auth if needed)
Capture card is connected and no other application is using it
If Guide is already open from a previous replan, we will press B to return to top level before navigating
Game name will be visible on Achievements, Stats, and official club pages as per success criteria
No error dialogs or 'Something went wrong' messages will appear during navigation
